positions.title: Senior AI Engineer
positions.description: Provided technical leadership for an 8-9-person team across system design, experimentation and code reviews; clarified stakeholder requirements and coordinated frontend/backend delivery.

sections.title: Enterprise contract intelligence & agent architecture
points: Designed the AI architecture for an enterprise contract-analysis platform serving approximately 1,000 users, using LangGraph to coordinate multi-step document review and tool-based analysis.
Made retrieved answers traceable to source documents through citation-backed retrieval; added response caching to reuse LLM outputs and evaluated lower-cost models against task requirements.
Preserved contract metadata and master-data history across revisions through snapshot versioning, supported by PostgreSQL/pgvector and OpenSearch data models.

sections.title: Enterprise integration & feature access
points: Integrated the contract platform with an internal AI service, addressing cross-service authentication and secure connectivity requirements within enterprise infrastructure.
Designed Salesforce Canvas and SSO integration to embed the contract platform into existing business workflows, defining application embedding and API contracts across systems.
Enabled business-unit-specific feature access through a Business Line permission matrix, enforcing the same feature restrictions across backend APIs and the application UI.

sections.title: Knowledge graphs & software lifecycle intelligence
points: Built traceable links between requirements, documentation, source code and defects in a knowledge graph, giving QA and engineering a connected view of information spread across Rally, wikis and code repositories.
Led a feasibility study for test generation grounded in requirement dependencies; modeled epic, feature and user-story relationships to supply context for scenarios spanning multiple requirements.

sections.title: Document intelligence & applied research
points: Designed ingestion to preserve document layout and section hierarchy for contextual retrieval; evaluated vision-language classification and document parsers to inform the pipeline design.

sections.title: Document extraction, workflow APIs & cloud delivery
points: Researched document-parsing approaches and led PDF parser development with Python libraries and Azure Document Intelligence, preserving layout for downstream extraction.
Applied cloud-based LLMs to automate structured data extraction and formatting, connecting PDF parsing to reusable document-processing workflows.
Designed LLM invocation scheduling and rate-limit handling to manage constrained API capacity across concurrent document-processing workloads.
Led backend development for a LangFlow-based application that lets users compose PDF processing workflows through a visual interface; built APIs for flow execution and modular parsing components.
Contributed Kubernetes deployment scripts and supported GCP rollout, working across backend integration and deployment troubleshooting.

sections.title: Vietnamese NLP, model optimization & conversational applications
points: Designed and maintained scripted chatbot interaction flows; integrated LangChain and prompt-based responses to handle open-ended queries beyond predefined scenarios.
Developed Vietnamese question-generation models using BARTPho and Marian, including custom pointer mechanisms for out-of-vocabulary handling.
Built sentiment-classification models for user messages to support analysis and visualization of chatbot interactions.
Fine-tuned pretrained language models using Hugging Face SFT Trainer and LoRA, with task-specific hyperparameter experimentation.
Applied ONNX and TorchScript for inference optimization; used DVC to version data and experiments and keep model iterations reproducible.
